mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, causing the S&P 500 to experience negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP by more than 2% on a quarterly basis signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the quarters when GDPC1 increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month indicates a slowdown in economic activity, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% in a month, it signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase as specified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals a strong labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 300k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE change as specified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month signals rising inflation, which can lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% on a quarterly basis signals a contraction in economic activity, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the quarters when GDPC1 decreases by more than 1%.
